description: This file defines an interface for refreshable AWS token providers, specifying methods for refreshing tokens and checking if a refresh should be attempted.

classes.name: RefreshableTokenProviderInterface
classes.description: An interface that provides methods for managing AWS token refresh logic.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Attempts to refresh the AWS token; returns a Token object or throws an Exception.

methods.name: shouldAttemptRefresh
methods.description: Determines if a token refresh should be attempted; returns a boolean.
